about: What Frankendom V3 hands @frankendom/physics every tick for the Minotaur (opponent "pitborn", body minotaur.glb on the 65 rig, measure row data/bodies/minotaur.measure.json) over ~15 s of a live fight at the game's own pace: the hero walks in and cuts about once a second (the Minotaur attacks, blocks, takes hits and staggers); both fighters' health held so nobody dies. One entry per physics tick, in order, at tickHz. root: rd.setRoot(position, quaternion) as [px, py, pz, qx, qy, qz, qw] (metres, in the fighter group's frame = the ragdoll's sim frame). target: rd.setTargetPose's 80 floats, 4 per part (x, y, z, w) in partIds order. Values from three-rig drive() (createThreeRig with the bind option), rounded to 5 decimals. Captured 2026-10-26 on a Mac M5 (headless Chrome, Metal) from Frankendom-v3 3311ca0 (physics 19af420, solveHinges false; the target pose does not depend on the motor tuning).
